scope: Selected cached reports: grants/Direct AY1999-2000 through 2024-25; FFEL through 2009-10; campus AY2001-02 through 2023-24. Policy coverage is scoped to interpretation of these reports.

common_semantics.panel_unit: FSA reporting unit OPEID8 by award year, not presumed IPEDS campus
common_semantics.award_year: July 1 through June 30; source loan cohort uses loan-period start
common_semantics.recipient_additivity: No school-level unique all-aid recipient count can be constructed from these program counts.
common_semantics.zero_rule: Only an explicit numeric source zero establishes observed zero; policy and column absence never impute institution values.
common_semantics.suppression_rule: For literal <10 recipient counts retain NA and an upper bound of 9; nonnegativity permits 0 as conservative lower bound unless a source establishes 1.
common_semantics.stock_flow: Volume describes origination/disbursement flows under report cohort definitions, not outstanding portfolio balances.
common_semantics.vintage: Cumulative Q4 is full-year coverage, not inherently final or common vintage across years.
unknowns: Dash semantics have not been established by an authoritative report legend.
Exact volume-report-to-FISAP cell lineage is not provided for every award year.
Suppression introduction rationale and proof that <10 excludes zero are not documented.
A source program/header boundary does not by itself identify an institution-level structural zero.
common_semantics.policy_date_rule: Policy effective_date is distinct from coarse first_affected_award_year_start annotations; legal rules may attach to loan-period start, first disbursement, credit check or other individual dates. Observed headers are separate evidence.
